We’ll collect information related to any purchases you make.

If you purchase in-game virtual currency or items in a game you play on any Zynga game website, our third-party payment processor will collect the billing and financial information it needs to process your charges. This may include your postal address, email address, and financial information. Where we use payment processors, they do not share your financial information, like credit card numbers, with Zynga, but they may share non-financial information with us related to your purchases, like your name, billing address, and the items purchased.

When you play Zynga’s games or access any of our other Services on connected third-party applications or platforms (like Facebook, Apple, Google, Snapchat, TikTok or Amazon), any purchases you make will be processed by that third-party application or platform and subject to that third-party application or platform’s terms of service and privacy policy. For these purchases, Zynga does not receive your financial information, but may receive non-financial information related to your purchases, like your name, approximate physical location, and the items purchased. The information Zynga receives depends on the Zynga game you’re playing and the third-party application or platform. The applicable Terms of Service explain our policies and terms related to charges, billing, third-party credits, and virtual currencies.
